svg.title: TESAIoT Dev Kit - QWA309 base board pinout (V3.1)
svg.text: TESAIoT Dev Kit - QWA309 base board pinout (V3.1)
TESA AIoT E84 Embedded AI Board, base board V3.1 (schematic rev V3_P1). Pin names are PSoC Edge E84 port.pin; U6 = the on-board PSoC 4000T.
I2C at 5 V, power ref SW11
2 touch buttons + slider, I2C 0x08 via SW12
P4 SWD + P5 I2C (1.8 V only)
Board picture: a stylised rendering based on the TESA reference image, not a photograph; labels re-checked against
schematic V3.1 and the B1 assembly drawing. SW5/SW6 labels are from the B1 assembly drawing. 'ref SWn' = schematic
name of a power slide switch. Unlabelled parts could not be identified in the picture.
Power for all three sockets comes from ref SW3 (MBUS power).
UART pins are listed as printed (TX / RX). Which one the MCU drives is not established from the schematic: check with your click first.
All P16.x, P17.2-P17.4 and P11.1 here are also camera J4 lines; P13.5 / P13.6 are also Arduino D3 / D4.
ON: +3.3V_CAM to camera J4 (U1 AP2553A). Red D1 lit = on.
ON: +3.3V_MBUS and +5V_MBUS to all three mikroBUS sockets (U2/U3). Red D2.
ON: +3.3V_ADU and +5V_ADU to Arduino J8 (U4/U5). Red D3.
ON: +5V_RGB to the RGB matrix (U12). Red D11.
ON: 4000T I2C (via Q5/Q6 1.8 V to 3.3 V) joins P17.0/P17.1. OFF: 4000T isolated.
ON: P16.3 = CAN TX (SN65HVD230 D), P16.2 = CAN RX (R). OFF: P16.2/P16.3 left to camera/SPI.
ON: P17.5 to RS-485 /RE, P17.7 to DE (ISL3178). Data P13.1 RX / P13.2 TX (SCB7) are always wired.
Firmware cannot read any of these positions. Schematic SW2 / SW3 / SW4 here are not the printed SW2 / SW3 / SW4 user inputs.
Shared I2C bus: P17.0 SCL / P17.1 SDA (3.3 V)
J7-1 SCL, J7-2 SDA; J10-6 SCL, J10-5 SDA
SCL / SDA pin of each socket
camera control bus of the DVP module
touch controller of the 4.3 in display
5 V side through BSS138 shifters Q7/Q8
address 0x08, via Q5/Q6 and SW12 ON
V3.1 only; B1 has no link
Arduino Uno R3 headers (3.3 V logic)
ADC_3 only on the SoM side of U7
ADC_2 only on the SoM side of U7
Buttons, slide switches, touch (active low = reads 0 when pressed)
10k pull-up to 1.8 V; read over I2C
10k pull-up to 1.8 V; read over I2C
which end is ON: not established;
which end is ON: not established;
no external pull-up on V3.1 (R43 not
no external pull-up on V3.1 (R44 not
fitted); camera J4-1/3; RS-485 DE via
shared TX on U6 P2.0; read over I2C
TX on U6 P1.0; read over I2C 0x08
no net for it in the V3.1 sheets' text
10k pots between 0 V and +1.8V_VCC_Analog, 100 nF on each wiper: range 0 to 1.8 V. Printed VR1 / VR2 sit on
schematic VR2 / VR1; firmware follows the printed labels.
U6 PSoC 4000T (CY8C4046LQI-T452), own firmware, 1.8 V. Flashing the E84 does not touch it.
U6 P2.2 SCL / P2.3 SDA (1.8 V) > Q5/Q6 shifter > SW12 ON > P17.0 / P17.1
no Q5/Q6/SW12: the 4000T is reachable only on header P5 (1.8 V)
1 +V_TARGET, 2 GND, 3 XRES, 4 SWCLK (U6 P3.3), 5 SWDIO (U6 P3.2). 1.8 V ONLY
1 +V_TARGET, 2 GND, 3 XRES, 4 SCL 1.8 V, 5 SDA 1.8 V. 1.8 V ONLY
lights only when a programmer drives pin 1 of P4/P5 (+V_TARGET). Dark D4 is normal.
Analog inputs on P15.x accept 0 to 1.8 V only. VR1-VR4 (P15.4-P15.7) are wired straight to the ADC. Arduino A0-A3 are not
Arduino D0-D13 are 3.3 V logic through TXB0106 auto-direction translators U7/U8/U9 (1.8 V SoM side). Do not use D8/D9 as
analog inputs: the translator is digital (inferred from the part, not measured).
D10 silkscreen misprint: the board prints P9.2; the pin is P9.0 (SPI SS). P9.2 is D11 (MOSI).
mikroBUS 3 has no MISO, so full SPI clicks will not work there. mikroBUS 1 carries only I2C and PWM.
SW6 (P17.5) and SW5 (P17.7) (labels from the B1 assembly drawing) share the camera control lines (J4 pins 2/4 and 1/3). P17.5
is also the USB-host VBUS enable. Set both as inputs with pull-up before reading: V3.1 fits no external pull-up and the stock BSP
Camera lines are shared: P16.0-P16.7, P17.2-P17.5, P17.7 and P11.1 also feed mikroBUS, CAN, RS-485, SW5 and SW6. Use
the camera or those functions, not both.
No I3C on the base board. The SoM uses I3C only internally.
CapSense link needs SW12 ON (V3.1). B1 boards have no SW12/SW13/SW14 and do fit pull-ups R43/R44 on SW6/SW5.
D4 (green, beside the SWD header) lights only when a programmer powers pin 1 of P4/P5.

Sources: QWA309 schematic rev V3_P1 (V3.1) sheets 8-22; QWA309 assembly drawing (variant B1) for silkscreen; board picture: a rendering based on the TESA reference image. Rows not established are marked in chapter J7 of the SDK documentation.
